blocks.raw: <Note>Nordic Modernism (Scandinavian Modernism) is fully modern—not anti-modern or nostalgic. It simply insists that modernism must be humanistic, regionally rooted, and craft-conscious. Aalto's influence spread throughout Scandinavian design (Danish furniture, Swedish glass, Finnish ceramics), creating a regional alternative to the International Style without rejecting modernism itself.</Note>

blocks.raw: <Warn>Critical distinctions: Aalto's organic curves are NOT Art Nouveau decoration—they're structural and functional, inspired by nature but serving human comfort and engineering logic. Also: bent plywood is NOT traditional craft—it's industrial technology (steam and molds) creating organic form. Aalto reconciles industry and craft, not retreats from modernism into nostalgia.</Warn>

Answer: B. You must understand his humanistic philosophy.</ExamTip>
